components.name: Primary invitation action
components.description: Brass, full-contrast action that advances invitation or sign-in flow.
components.css: .wns-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1.5rem; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.85rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--aw-accent); border-radius: var(--aw-radius-control); background: var(--aw-accent); color: var(--aw-on-accent); font: 600 var(--aw-text-body)/1.4 var(--aw-font-ui); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color var(--aw-motion-fast) var(--aw-ease-out), border-color var(--aw-motion-fast) var(--aw-ease-out), color var(--aw-motion-fast) var(--aw-ease-out); } .wns-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .wns-action:focus-visible { outline: var(--aw-focus-width) solid var(--aw-info); outline-offset: var(--aw-focus-offset); }

components.name: Identity text field
components.description: Labeled text entry with an ink surface, a visible border, and a full-size touch target.
components.css: .wns-field { display: grid; gap: var(--aw-space-2); min-width: 0; color: var(--aw-ivory); font: 600 var(--aw-text-label)/1.4 var(--aw-font-ui); } .wns-field input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: var(--aw-touch); padding: var(--aw-space-2) var(--aw-space-3); border: 1px solid var(--aw-border); border-radius: var(--aw-radius-control); background: var(--aw-void); color: var(--aw-ivory); font: 400 var(--aw-text-body)/1.4 var(--aw-font-ui); } .wns-field input:focus-visible { outline: var(--aw-focus-width) solid var(--aw-info); outline-offset: var(--aw-focus-offset); }

narrative.overview:
Wand Night Stand uses an editorial serif voice, warm brass accents, ink-plum surfaces, and original curtain and night-flower artwork to make the invitation and countdown feel intimate and quietly theatrical. Inter keeps navigation, actions, copy, and numerical information grounded and legible.

This guidance applies to the consumer-facing application identity. The shared design system, simulator, offline CAD viewer, firmware, protocols, and engineering labels retain Vapour Chrome and their compatibility identifiers.
keyCharacteristics: Self-hosted Cormorant Garamond display lettering with Inter interface typography.
Ink and plum surfaces, ivory text, and restrained brass actions.
Readable full-name editorial logo with wand underline and state-specific artwork.
Responsive invitation and countdown layouts with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Consumer Boundary Rule
rules.body: Apply the consumer identity within the application; keep the shared engineering system, simulator, and offline CAD surfaces in Vapour Chrome.

rules.name: The Curtain First Rule
rules.body: Use the curtain artwork for prelaunch and invitations; reserve the keepsake still life for postlaunch archive states.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the editorial face for brand and headings; use Inter for controls, body copy, and numerical information.

dos: Preserve keyboard focus indicators and reduce the portrait fade when reduced motion is requested.
Keep administrator-authored teaser and host-note copy verbatim; interface chrome labels it as original-language text because no translation capability is provided.
Retain existing persisted theme and engineering compatibility identifiers.
donts: Do not show suitcase imagery or postlaunch keepsake artwork on prelaunch surfaces.
Do not apply consumer colors to shared engineering tools or alter technical labels as a visual cleanup.
